cohort: 103 patients undergoing elective caesarean section at Patna Medical College & Hospital.
finding: Ondansetron significantly reduced spinal-induced hypotension, vasopressor use, nausea, and vomiting compared to placebo, without harming neonates.
mod_finding: The study found that ondansetron can prevent spinal anesthesia-related hypotension in patients undergoing caesarean sections.
